page.layout: One page: title page. Centred lines of type from top to bottom, with a woodcut of a tree and a banner ("ET FLOR. & FRUCTU.") in the middle and the imprint at the foot. Library stamps are on the page and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Juris in Acad. Ultraject. Antecessoris, & Vianensis Camerae

page.notes: The woodcut (a tree with a banner reading "ET FLOR[?] ... FRUCTU" and a figure beside it) is an engraving, not text. The line "Ex omni Jure decis..." is partly covered by a round stamp, so the end of the word is illegible. The imprint year is printed as an old-style numeral (clɔ Iɔ c LVIII) and is given here as MDCLVIII. Stamps (Biblioteca Nazionale, Roma, Vittorio Emanuele) are not transcribed.
